name: Food Quality and Safety
description: The course will cover food hazards and spoilages, food microorganisms and their classifications an governing factors, food-borne diseases, beneficial food microorganisms and their role in food processing and human health, techniques for improving food safety and quality, traceability, food recalls, residue monitoring plan, food safety strategies and management techniques, national and international food laws, regulations and standards, nutrition labeling, traceability, food recalls, residue monitoring plan, food safety management systems, GHP, GMP, ISO, HACPP, risk analysis and management, instrumentation techniques for food safety and quality.
